title: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers

result.label: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers
result.statement: Resolves the Erdős–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture: the logarithmic sizes of the largest prime factors of n and n+1 are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density. In particular, the integers satisfying P^+(n) P^+(n+1) have density 1/2.
